snippet.title: IMMERROCK Early Access Meta Quest Trailer
snippet.description:
IMMERROCK Early Access transforms the way you learn and practice guitar!
Learn guitar with a clear path and bite-sized exercises that will inspire you to MASTER FASTER your guitar.

GUIDED BITE-SIZED EXERCISES
Got 15 minutes? That’s enough! Our lessons and exercises are designed to fit into your busy day.
+100 exercises, lessons and songs (and many more to come)

YOUR PATH TO MASTER GUITAR
Learn new exercises, lessons, techniques and songs tailored to your goals and skill level.

PRACTICE AT YOUR SPEED
Adjust the speed anytime to learn cool songs or practice your favorite exercises

FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS
Say goodbye to staring at your computer or phone, IMMERROCK lets you focus on what really matters: Your GUITAR and your FINGERS

CONVERT YOU MIDI FILES
Convert your tracks and enjoy all the features of IMMERROCK

STAY MOTIVATED
Complete daily quests and many more features to come to keep motivation high.

RETAIN YOUR LEARNING
Develop an intuition and the muscle memory to play anywhere anytime.
